# Agustín Avellaneda — AI-Powered Fullstack Developer & PM

URL: https://www.agustin.top
Email: me@agustin.top
Location: Catamarca, Argentina (remote / worldwide)

## About

Agustín Avellaneda is a product-minded fullstack developer and project manager with 9+ years shipping digital products. Started as a Mining Technician in Argentina; transitioned to tech through self-learning and real projects. Founder of Excelso (https://excelso.xyz). Builds MVPs in 2-4 weeks, works directly with founders and product leads, and combines AI tools with solid engineering to reduce time-to-value.

## What I do

- AI-powered fullstack development (React, Next.js, Astro, Node.js, Express, Fastify, TypeScript)
- Product management and technical discovery
- MVPs that ship in weeks, not months
- Onboarding flows, dashboards with actionable metrics, event-based notifications
- Landing pages for ideas, projects and companies
- B2B SaaS, marketplaces, internal tools, fintech, healthtech and education products

## Featured projects

- Around Notes — AI note-taking for meetings and research (aroundnotes.ai)

- JEMA — AI platform for measuring environmental and social impact

- Fuddy — event and booking management platform
